newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Trygg-Hansa Life transfers Trygg-Hansa AB shares.
newsitem.headline: Trygg-Hansa Life transfers Trygg-Hansa AB shares.

text.p: Swedish insurer Trygg-Hansa Mutual Life Insurance Co said on Thursday it had transferred two million A series shares and 19.6 million B series shares in Trygg-Hansa AB to Trygg Stiftelsen (Trygg Foundation).
"The foundation's objective is to look after the life insurance policy holders' interests in Trygg-Hansa," the company said in a statement.
The shares correspond to 26.2 percent of the capital and 39.4 percent of votes in Trygg-Hansa AB.
This holding will be reduced to about 23.7 percent of capital and about 39.4 percent of votes, in accordance with a redemption programme that Trygg-Hansa AB will carry out in August.
